data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6133 reported a prior year reserve release of $16.145 million for the 2018 year of account, representing a 23.83% release of opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development is attributed to stable or reduced gross loss estimates, despite industry-wide deterioration from 2018 and 2019 natural catastrophe events in the US and Japan. The syndicate underwrites quota share reinsurance of Property Treaty business.
raw_causal_phrases: improvement of $12,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end.
For Syndicate 6133 the gross loss estimates have remained fairly stable and in some instances have actually reduced.
This indicates a prudent approach to loss estimation, and assists in managing the expectations of reinsurance counterparties.
data.data_quality_notes: The narrative states a NET improvement of $12,197k, while the gross year of account result for 2018 is a profit of $16,145k (implying a gross release of -16.145m). The gross claims development triangle for 2018 shows a release of -16.252m. The YOA result is used as the primary source for prior year development.
